edbDesc: The process of weathering and transport of solids (sediment, soil, rock and other particles) in the natural environment or their source and deposits them elsewhere. It usually occurs due to transport by wind, water, or ice; by down-slope creep of soil and other material under the force of gravity; or by living organisms, such as burrowing animals, in the case of bioerosion.
title: Erosion
pickWhy: An everyday natural process; slow geological change is already in the deck (uniformitarianism).
